title.zh: 【《国家信息化「十五五」规划》：到 2030 年国家区块链网络基本建成】
title.en: 【《国家信息化「十五五」规划》：到 2030 年国家区块链网络基本建成】

current_state.zh: China's Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization, which targets basic completion of a national blockchain network by 2030 alongside 6G commercialization and expanded cyber/AI infrastructure across ten task areas and seven dedicated initiatives.
current_state.en: China's Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization, which targets basic completion of a national blockchain network by 2030 alongside 6G commercialization and expanded cyber/AI infrastructure across ten task areas and seven dedicated initiatives.
